recommendation_details.action: Continue the planned mission while monitoring live engine telemetry.
recommendation_details.label: Continue
recommendation_details.reason: No critical engine or mission constraint was identified in the simulated mission.

allowable_load.basis: Heuristic prototype relationship using thermal margin, vibration margin, health and degradation reserve.

available_rpm.basis: Prototype reference RPM limit combined with current engine condition.

engine_capability_envelope.basis: Prototype engine capability envelope derived from current telemetry, Digital Twin estimates, AI health/degradation and predicted endurance.
engine_capability_envelope.certification_note: Prototype/model-derived estimate. Not a certified engine operating envelope. Reference RPM/load limits must be replaced with validated engine-specific data before operational use.

predicted_endurance.basis: Predicted Remaining Useful Life from the existing AI RUL model.

provenance.source_semantics: MIXED means the current engine state contains multiple provenance classes; inspect each parameter source separately.

thermal_margin.basis: Weighted critical-limit margin: CHT 40%, EGT 40%, oil temperature 20%.
thermal_margin.margin_semantics: Percentage represents normalized distance from the critical limit; it is not a certified operating limit or warning-threshold score.

vibration_margin.margin_semantics: Normalized distance from the critical vibration limit.
